notes: MiniMax H3 image-to-video AND text-to-video in one graph: the fl2va weight does t2va when no image is connected (per the workflow's own note). This SUPERSEDES the r2v workflow as the first H3 catalog target. Ollama enhancer bypassed as always; the panel enhances with its own chat model.

panelAdaptation.reason: Node 138's prompt input is LINKED from the Ollama rewriter (169 -> 170 -> link 313), so any value injected into the prompt widget is ignored. Dropping the two enhancer nodes hands the widget back its own value, which is what the panel injects. The panel enhances with its own chat model, so the Ollama round trip is dead weight either way.

procedural.enhancerInstruction: in this manifest - the TEMPLATE half of node 169, with the USER IDEA tail stripped: the panel sends it as the system turn and the user's idea as the user turn (planEnhancement already separates these)

durationSeconds.note: seconds in; the graph's ComfyMathExpression (node 135) converts to the model's 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps - inject seconds, never frames. injectParams REFUSES a 'frames' param on this template rather than write a frame count into a seconds widget.

prompt.note: the adapted API template (panelAdaptation above) dropped the Ollama pair, so this widget owns its own value again and injectParams writes straight to it. H3 carries the prompt on the sampler node, not a CLIPTextEncode, which is why the generic walk cannot find it.

firstFrame.note: LoadImage - i2v reference. With no image the panel DELETES this node and every input linked to it: first_frame is an OPTIONAL input on MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo (measured from ComfyUI 0.32.0 INPUT_TYPES, see scripts/comfy-node-defs.json), so the fl2va weight then runs text-to-video. Detaching is not optional politeness - the authored filename exists only on the owner's machine and would fail validation for every other user.

resolution.note: megapixels float driving ResolutionSelector (node 115), which owns the aspect_ratio combo - so width x height can only set the AREA, and injectParams says so in its applied list. Cap is H3's native 768x1344 = 1.03 MP.

optionalNodesNote: Every non-core class this graph uses is listed here, so the template loads on a bare ComfyUI 0.32.0 with the models and no custom packs at all. Decided per node 2026-08-28 against the running loader's /object_info signatures and measured with a real bare-graph generation (see WORKPLAN-LOG). Each entry is a demotion, not a deletion: with the pack installed the node is KEPT, so the owner's machine renders exactly the graph that was authored.

optionalNodes.reason: a live-preview transport for ComfyUI's own canvas — it changes what a BROWSER draws mid-sample and nothing about the sampled result, and the panel never opens that canvas
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: it decodes preview frames during sampling, which costs a little VRAM and time for a picture nobody in the panel path looks at

optionalNodes.reason: a step-skipping residual cache: pure latency, and its own mode names ('H3 Safe / Fast / Aggressive') are a fidelity-for-speed trade. Bypassed, every step is computed — slower and no less correct
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept on 'H3 Safe', so some steps reuse the cached first-block residual

optionalNodes.reason: swaps in a memory-efficient attention kernel. Bypassed, attention falls back to whatever the installed torch provides, which is correct but hungrier
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: this is the entry most worth having on a small card — it lowers attention VRAM, so a machine without kjnodes may need a shorter clip or fewer megapixels to fit

optionalNodes.reason: a scheduled sparse-attention approximation (tau_start 1.25 -> tau_end 0.8): faster sampling at some fidelity cost by construction. Bypassed, attention stays dense the whole way — the slower, more faithful path
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: its second output (tau_graph, an IMAGE) is a diagnostic this template never wires up, so only the MODEL socket matters here

optionalNodes.reason: a VRAM-cleanup pass-through wedged between VAEDecode and the upscaler; it forwards the images untouched. ComfyUI frees its own models between prompts, and the panel's VRAM arbiter does the deliberate half (POST /free before chat reloads), so nothing depends on this node
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: it empties the torch cache mid-graph, which trims the peak a little on the owner's machine

optionalNodes.reason: plays notify.mp3 on the ComfyUI machine when the queue empties. It is a terminal node — nothing in the graph consumes its output — so dropping it removes a chime and nothing else
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: the owner's ComfyUI will beep when a panel-driven render finishes. Left as the template author wrote it; making it unconditional is a product decision, not a portability one

optionalNodes.reason: the megapixel source, and the one node here that CANNOT be bypassed: its only input is a literal, so its consumers (ResolutionSelector.megapixels) would have nothing to rewire to. Core PrimitiveFloat has the identical FLOAT output and is already used twice in this same graph (nodes 136, 150), so it is a swap, not a workaround
optionalNodes.substituteNote: ComfyLiterals' Float declares Number as a STRING widget and the template carries ".98"; PrimitiveFloat wants a FLOAT, hence the 'as: number' coercion. Both signatures measured from /object_info on 2026-08-28. The panel's resolution injection writes node 167 BEFORE optional nodes resolve, so an injected megapixel figure is carried across by the same rule
optionalNodes.keptNote: kept: identical behaviour either way — this substitution exists to delete a pack dependency, not to change a render

optionalNodes.reason: ships in comfyui_nvidia_rtx_nodes and needs the NVIDIA app video SDK, so it registers on some machines and not others; the graph must still run where it does not
optionalNodes.keptNote: it rescales the finished frames to a FIXED 1920x1080, so the saved file is 1080p whatever megapixel figure was injected above

customNodes.optionalReason: every class it contributes here (Float) is substituted by a core node when the pack is absent — see optionalNodes
every class it contributes here (PlaySound|pysssss) is bypassable — see optionalNodes
customNodes.note: CORRECTION to the 2026-08-25 scan: there is no collision. This pack registers PlaySound|pysssss and ComfyUI-KJNodes registers PlaySoundKJ - different class names, both resolved at once on the scan machine. Measured 2026-08-27 from /object_info.

customNodes.optionalReason: every class it contributes here (easy cleanGpuUsed) is bypassable — see optionalNodes

every class it contributes here (ModelPreviewOverrideKJ, MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch) is bypassable — see optionalNodes. Bypassing the attention patch RAISES VRAM, so it is the one to install first on a small card
every class it contributes here (ApplyMiniMaxH3FirstBlockCache) is bypassable — see optionalNodes
customNodes.note: CORRECTION to the 2026-08-25 scan: only ApplyMiniMaxH3FirstBlockCache comes from this pack. ComfyMathExpression does NOT - the running loader reports it as comfy_extras.nodes_math, i.e. CORE in ComfyUI 0.32.0. Measured 2026-08-27 from /object_info.

customNodes.optionalReason: every class it contributes here (MiniMaxH3ScheduledSolAttentionPatch) is bypassable — see optionalNodes

customNodes.note: NVIDIA-app dependent. MUST be bypassable — the panel bypasses it unless the node resolves.

Every class listed here resolves to nodes.py or comfy_extras/* in ComfyUI 0.32.0 - no pack needed. The MiniMaxH3* and ResolutionSelector classes in particular are core, not custom, which is easy to get backwards. CORRECTION to the 2026-08-25 scan: there is no ResolutionSelector collision either - ComfyUI-UtilsCollection registers ResolutionSelectorExtended, a different class name.

enhancerInstruction:
You rewrite a rough video idea into MiniMax H3 image-to-video (I2VA) prompt format. Output ONLY the finished prompt. No preamble, no explanation, no markdown fences.

REQUIRED STRUCTURE, exactly this order:

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] ...
[Shot 2] At MM:SS.mmm, ...
[Shot 3] At MM:SS.mmm, ...

overall_soundscape: ...

non_diegetic_music: ...

RULES
- Shot 1 opens with a style declaration (e.g. "Live-action, cinematic,") then anchors to the reference image: state that the subject shown in <Picture 1> keeps their face, hair, clothing and surroundings, then describe the action forward.
- [Shot 1] has no timestamp. Later shots use "At MM:SS.mmm," with millisecond precision.
- Camera motion in natural prose with type, amplitude and speed: "The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as..." Never stack camera labels.
- Describe ONLY what is visible or audible. No thoughts, intentions, emotions, backstory or meaning. Convert interiority into observable cues: widened eyes, tightened jaw, a sharp intake of breath.
- Do not contradict the reference image: identity, clothing, colours, key objects and spatial relationships stay consistent.
- Speakers get stable IDs (S1), (S2), or (S1,S2) together. Dialogue goes in <d>[English] exact words</d> with the user's words preserved verbatim. Omit entirely if there is no dialogue.
- On-screen text goes in double quotes, verbatim, untranslated.
- overall_soundscape: 1-4 sentences, one paragraph. Ambience, physical action sounds, non-verbal human sounds. Never repeat dialogue or diegetic music. "N/A" only if silence is requested.
- non_diegetic_music: 1-3 sentences on instrumentation, tempo, rhythm and dynamic change. No mood adjectives, no explaining emotional effect. "N/A" if none.
- Target 250-400 words total. Default to 3 shots spread across the clip duration unless the idea implies otherwise.
